name: app.airtune/radio
title: Airtune Radio
description: Search 50,000+ live radio stations: what's playing, on air now, recent songs, schedules, charts.

tools.name: search_stations
tools.description: Find live radio stations in Airtune's catalogue of 50,000+ stations from 200+ countries. Search by name (typo-tolerant) and/or filter by country, genre, mood or language. With no query, returns the most popular stations matching the filters. Returns each station's slug (needed by the other tools) and its Airtune page URL, where the user can listen.

query.description: Station name or part of it, e.g. "BBC Radio 1" or "kexp".

genre.description: Genre tag, e.g. "jazz". The main genres, with the most stations: classical, country, dance, electronic, folk, hip-hop, jazz, news, pop, religious, rock, talk. The filter matches a station tag exactly, so some other common tags also work ("ambient", "lofi", "top40") with fewer stations, but spelling matters: "smooth-jazz" matches nothing. If a genre returns no stations, use the closest main genre or put the style in `query` instead of guessing another tag.

mood.description: Mood id, one of: chill, energetic, focus, relax, happy, sleep. Any other value matches no station. For a mood not in this list, use the closest one, or describe the style with `genre` or `query`.

locale.description: Language for country, genre and language names (ISO 639-1). Default: en.

tools.name: get_station
tools.description: Details of one radio station: country, languages, genres, description, website, broadcaster group, the song playing right now (when the station sends titles), and the programme on air now and next (when the station publishes a schedule). Use this to answer "what's playing on X". Needs the station slug from search_stations.

locale.description: Language for country, genre and language names (ISO 639-1). Default: en.

tools.name: recent_tracks
tools.description: The songs Airtune detected on a station, newest first, with the time each one started (UTC). Detection reads the artist and title the station sends with its stream, so talk and news stations, and stations that send no titles, have no songs. Needs the station slug from search_stations.

tools.name: station_schedule
tools.description: One day of a station's programme schedule (EPG): each show's name, host and start/end time, with the station's UTC offset. Only stations that publish a schedule have one. Covers today and the next 6 days in the station's own time zone. Needs the station slug from search_stations.

date.description: Day in the station's time zone, YYYY-MM-DD: today or one of the next 6 days. Default: today. Past dates are rejected; there is no schedule history. For songs that already played, use recent_tracks (the latest 50 songs).

tools.name: airing_now
tools.description: Radio programmes on air right now (or starting within 30 minutes), across stations that publish a schedule, most popular stations first. Optionally limited to one country. Each item names the show, its station and the station's Airtune page.

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code, e.g. "DE". Default: all countries.

tools.name: country_top_tracks
tools.description: The songs played most often on a country's radio stations in the last 7 days, as measured by Airtune from the titles stations send with their streams (not a sales or streaming chart). Each song names one station that played it.

tools.name: list_categories
tools.description: The valid values for search_stations filters: country codes, genre slugs, mood slugs or language codes, each with a display name and the number of stations. Largest first.

locale.description: Language for country, genre and language names (ISO 639-1). Default: en.
